◊Legal Disclaimers

Accessories: Accessories are sold separately; availability varies by region.

Advanced Security with Touch ID: Magic Keyboard with Touch ID is included with iMac systems with 12-core CPU.

Apple Intelligence and Siri AI: Apple Intelligence is available with Siri and device language set to Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish or Vietnamese. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Siri AI is available in beta in macOS 27 and requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled device set to a supported language. Available in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish to start. Siri AI will not be initially available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS. Siri AI is not available for users under 13. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits, including but not limited to Siri AI, Intelligent Photo Editing Tools, Image Playground and AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts. Daily limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies and other factors. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions. Learn more at support.apple.com/en-in/148587.

Apps: Apps shown may be available on the App Store; some software may be sold separately. Some apps and services may require a subscription.

Colour Availability: iMac 24″ colour availability may vary.

Display: Screen size is measured diagonally. Actual diagonal screen size of the 24″ iMac is 59.62 cm (23.5″).

FaceTime: FaceTime calling requires a FaceTime-enabled device for the caller and recipient, and a Wi-Fi connection. Availability over a cellular network depends on carrier policies; data charges may apply.

Feature, App and Service Availability: Features are subject to change. Some features, applications and services may not be available in all regions or all languages.

iCloud+: Subscription is required. The Apple TV subscription included with iCloud+ does not include third-party branded subscription services or content available for rental or purchase in the Apple TV app. Some iCloud features require a Wi-Fi connection and are not available in all countries or regions. Access to some services is limited to 10 devices.

iPhone Mirroring: iPhone Mirroring is not available in all countries and regions. Some iPhone features (e.g. camera and microphone) are not compatible with iPhone Mirroring.

Storage: Actual formatted capacity of SSD storage is less.

Thunderbolt Ports: Port configuration varies by model.

Up to 18x Faster than the Most Popular Intel-Based iMac: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production 24″ iMac systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, 32GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD, as well as production 21.5″ iMac systems with 3.0GHz 6-core Intel Core i5, Radeon Pro 560X with 4GB of GDDR5 memory, 8GB of RAM and 256GB SSD. Super resolution was tested on a 16MB file with Pixelmator Pro v4.3 on M6 units, and Pixelmator Pro v3.8 with macOS Sequoia 15.8 on Intel-based systems. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of iMac.

Up to 3.3x Faster Graphics Performance than iMac with M1: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production 24″ iMac systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, 32GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD, as well as production 24″ iMac systems with Apple M1, 8-core CPU, 8-core GPU, 16GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD. Tested with Affinity v3.2.2 (4850) using the built-in benchmark version 32200. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of iMac.

Up to 2.5x Faster Productivity Performance than iMac with M1: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production 24″ iMac systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, 32GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD, as well as production 24″ iMac systems with Apple M1, 8-core CPU, 8-core GPU, 16GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD. Tested with a selection of tasks using Microsoft Excel v16.112.4. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of iMac.

Wi-Fi 7: Wi-Fi 7 availability varies by country. For more information, visit support.apple.com/en-in/148165.
